gaps.text: In-line measurement of Temperature with bioreactor temperature sensor

Both probes must sample the same bioreactor zone and the data must be normalised to a common time step. The fused model must beat the best single method on held-out runs, otherwise the second instrument is dropped.)

items.finding: Low-level data fusion is described as the simplest combination approach, where variables from different sources are concatenated into a single new data matrix.
items.how_it_applies: This supports the planned augmented-matrix approach for synchronised Raman and NIR spectra; the assessment can check that the concatenation and block scaling are implemented as described before judging fused-model performance.
items.limits_and_transfer_risks: The review is generic and not specific to bioreactor Raman/NIR pairs, so the simplicity claim does not guarantee better predictions in this aqueous cell culture matrix.

citation.quote: Low-level data fusion (LLDF) is considered the simplest method to achieve a combination of inputs. In this case, the data is rearranged into a new data matrix, where the variables coming from different sources are placed one after the other.
citation.label: E01 ¶31

items.finding: The review states that each dataset's contribution and complementarity should be evaluated before fusing data from multiple sources.
items.how_it_applies: This justifies the planned baseline of one calibration per method and the requirement that the fused model beat the best single method on held-out runs before keeping the second instrument.
items.limits_and_transfer_risks: The statement is a general recommendation from a review, not a validated protocol for this bioreactor, so complementarity must still be demonstrated on the customer's own runs.

citation.quote: Before fusing data from multiple sources, it is essential to evaluate the contribution of each dataset to the model and its complementarity.
citation.label: E01 ¶82

items.finding: A cited Raman and FT-IR food study showed that instrument complementarity alone was sometimes not enough to improve prediction of several quality attributes.
items.how_it_applies: This is a reason to treat the fused model's advantage over the best single method as an open question to be tested on held-out runs rather than assumed.
items.limits_and_transfer_risks: The cited example is a food application with Raman/FT-IR, not a cell culture bioreactor with Raman/NIR, so the outcome may differ here.

citation.quote: In some situations, instrument complementarity (not data complementarity) was not sufficient to improve the performance of predictive several CQAs, as shown by a Raman and FT-IR data based food analytical study [73].
citation.label: E01 ¶36

items.finding: For biopharmaceutical Raman use, the probe housing must be compatible with the installation environment, process chemistry, and sterilization and cleaning protocols across multiple scales.
items.how_it_applies: The assessment should verify that any candidate Raman probe's housing is specified for the customer's sterilisation and cleaning regime before pilot selection.
items.limits_and_transfer_risks: This is a general requirement statement from a review, not a validated sterilisation procedure for the customer's specific cell culture process or probe model.

citation.quote: The first requirement is that the probe housing needs to be compatible with the installation environment, process chemistry, and sterilization and cleaning protocols across multiple scales.
citation.label: E03 ¶23

items.finding: Fiber optic probes with backscattered geometry and a focus slightly away from the optical window have been reported to give consistent and robust results across scales.
items.how_it_applies: This suggests a probe geometry worth considering for robustness against fouling at the optical window in a cell culture environment, to be checked against the customer's cleaning constraints.
items.limits_and_transfer_risks: The cited results come from other processes and scales, so consistency in this aqueous cell culture medium and with the customer's sterilisation cycle is not established.

citation.quote: Thus, fiber optic probes with a backscattered optical fiber geometry with a focus slightly away from the optical window have been shown to yield consistent and robust results across scales [45, 46].
citation.label: E03 ¶24
